RECOVERY DESK / FIELD NOTES
A little BASIC.
A little patience.
  1. Choose a disk. Read its story and expected output.
  2. Run the damaged program. Follow the executed lines and variable values.
  3. Edit the program and run again. A memory returns when all input checks pass.
New to BASIC? LET assigns a value, INPUT reads the supplied numbers, PRINT shows a value, and IF … THEN 60 jumps to line 60 when its condition is true. GOTO jumps unconditionally; END stops.
The interpreter uses a small, bounded language. It cannot run JavaScript or read your files. You can inspect its trace even when a program gets stuck in a loop.
Gemma clues can be useful and can be wrong. Recorded clues come from actual local model runs on the original programs. Loading the browser model enables new clues for your edits, with no code sent to a server.
